versions.content: Usage of BswAsynchronousServerCallPoint The meta-class BswAsynchronousServerCallPoint aggregated in the role call- Point in a BswModuleEntity allows to declare which entry of another module (or the same module) is called asynchronously in the code of the client-side BswMod- uleEntity via the BSW Scheduler. The intended use case is inter-partition or inter-core communication. Note that it is a valid use case for a given BswInternalBehavior to have two different BswMod- uleEntity -s which eventually run on different partitions and/or processor cores.
